target_market: Primarily European and North American customers. Use relevant everyday contexts and natural English for newly authored advertising copy unless the user asks otherwise; preserve original product labels and locked copy exactly.
reference_role: The attached original image is evidence for visible product identity, counts, details and relative scale. Its advertising copy is source wording, not automatic proof of every claim. Unverified wording may inspire separately labelled creative marketing concepts; scene and layout may change as requested.
marketing_concepts_rule: For each unverified source claim or inferred audience need worth using, record its exact wording/source, mark evidence_status as unverified_creative, specify an aspirational scene or subjective value and a claim_boundary. Keep it outside verified product facts. Do not visually demonstrate or caption unverified material, certification, fit, durability, waterproofing, efficacy, performance or guarantees as established facts.

scene.extra_props_rule: Avoid unnecessary new props and objects that imply additional included merchandise.

camera.framing: Keep complete products visible with a clear focal hierarchy.

lighting.physical_consistency: Rebuild believable shadows, contact, reflections and material texture for the new scene.

human_presence.casting_rule: By default, do not depict Asian faces among lead, supporting or recognizable background people. An explicit user task prompt requesting Asian casting or preserving a specific person's identity overrides this default only for the specified people. A reference face, Chinese copy or an Asian location alone is not such a request. Apply this at every reconstruction depth; skin tone is not a substitute for casting. Do not add people or visible faces to people-free, hands-only or back-view scenes. Preserve faces and character artwork printed on the product.
human_presence.rule: Only include people or hands when relevant. Preserve person count, role, believable anatomy and product-to-hand scale. Across a batch with enough visible people, target 75% women (acceptable 70-80%) and 25% men (20-30%); target visible skin-tone distribution is 70% light/fair, 15% medium-brown, and 15% dark. Treat these only as visual appearance groups, never infer ethnicity or nationality. Approximate for small batches and honor source roles and explicit user locks; do not add people only to satisfy ratios. Adults are the default. Include a minor only when the source or user calls for one, and then show a clearly identifiable adult accompanying them in the same frame; never depict a minor alone. Apply depth-guided appearance changes only to unlocked scene participants. At depths 5-6, specify at least three concrete facial/styling changes; at 7-10 specify at least four, such as face shape, eye shape/spacing, brow, nose, lips, hair silhouette/color, makeup, or overall styling. Expression, makeup intensity, or hair color alone does not count as a distinct face redesign. Preserve the identity of portrait subjects or user-locked people, and all faces/patterns on merchandise. If only hands/back views are visible, do not invent a visible face; if no people, do not add people for this dimension. For a visible human face, plan a concrete depth-guided expression change independently of identity changes; preserve identity when locked but allow expression changes unless expression itself is explicitly locked. Greater depth means more redesign freedom, not stronger or exaggerated emotion. Preserve product character expressions and advertising emojis. By default preserve the source emotional tone at every depth; depth controls only expression variation within that tone. Only an explicit user request may change the emotional direction. A high depth, scene change or recasting is not authorization to turn smiles into crying, sadness or anger. If emotion is unclear, record visible cues and uncertainty and adjust conservatively.

batch_person_allocation.target_gender_ratio: women 75% (acceptable 70-80%), men 25% (acceptable 20-30%); approximate for small batches
batch_person_allocation.target_visible_skin_tone_ratio: light/fair 70%, medium-brown 15%, dark 15%; visual tone only, do not infer ethnicity
batch_person_allocation.minors: Adults by default; any minor must be visibly accompanied by an adult in the same frame

text_overlay.rule: Preserve user-locked advertising wording and emojis and original product labels. Newly authored copy defaults to natural English for European/North American customers. Unverified source claims may inspire creative scene and subjective copy but must not be stated as proven product properties.

avoid: Duplicated or missing primary products or essential accessories
Changed product pattern, structure, holes, connectors, packaging or visible labels
Fused objects, implausible relative scale or malformed hands
At moderate or high reconstruction levels, using only mirroring, cropping, recoloring or blurring instead of actual scene and composition changes
